data: {"result":{"tools":[{"name":"cloud_dispatch","description":"Dispatch a versioned cloud job (CloudJobRequestV1 envelope; HTTP and MCP admit the identical schema).
autonomy="pipeline" requires kind + input. Available kinds and the input fields each one accepts:
- research.question = the question to research (required)
- research.search = search backend: "tavily" or "brave" use the platform web-search vendor; anything else falls back to the model's native web search
- code-review.diff = unified diff to review (takes precedence over `code`)
- code-review.code = source to review when no diff is given
- docs.code = source to document
- docs.type = document type, e.g. "readme" (default) or "api"
- office-report.topic = what the document should cover (alias: `task`)
- office-report.task = alias of `topic`
- office-report.format = "docx" | "pptx" | "xlsx"; any other value falls back to "docx"
- office-report.data = optional JSON data embedded into the generated document
- data-analysis.csv = CSV text to analyse (alias: `data`)
- data-analysis.data = alias of `csv`
- data-analysis.question = what to find out (alias: `task`); defaults to a general summary
- data-analysis.task = alias of `question`
- bugfix.files = map of path to file content the fix applies to
- bugfix.error = the failure or requirement to fix (alias: `task`)
- bugfix.task = alias of `error`
- bugfix.testCmd = shell command run in the sandbox after the patch is applied
- migration.files = map of path to file content to migrate
- migration.goal = the migration or refactor goal (alias: `task`)
- migration.task = alias of `goal`
Any other kind is refused before dispatch with code "unknown_pipeline_kind"; input fields not listed for the chosen kind are ignored.
autonomy="bounded-agent" requires objective + capabilities, a free-form string array in which {code_exec, file_mutation} route the job to the sandboxed tier.
